For managed production workflows, Arize also offers \u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/products/ax/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eArize AX\u003c/a\u003e. Phoenix provides:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/tracing/llm-traces\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cem\u003eTracing\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e - Trace your LLM application's runtime using OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/evaluation/llm-evals\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cem\u003eEvaluation\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e - Leverage LLMs to benchmark your application's performance using response and retrieval evals.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/datasets-and-experiments/overview-datasets\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cem\u003eDatasets\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e - Create versioned datasets of examples for experimentation, evaluation, and fine-tuning.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/datasets-and-experiments/overview-datasets#experiments\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cem\u003eExperiments\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e - Track and evaluate changes to prompts, LLMs, and retrieval.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/prompt-engineering/overview-prompts\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cem\u003ePlayground\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e- Optimize prompts, compare models, adjust parameters, and replay traced LLM calls.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/prompt-engineering/overview-prompts/prompt-management\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cem\u003ePrompt Management\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e- Manage and test prompt changes systematically using version control, tagging, and experimentation.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/pxi\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cem\u003ePXI (Phoenix Intelligence)\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e - An AI engineering agent built into Phoenix for debugging traces, iterating on prompts, and navigating the product.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/integrations/remote-mcp\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cem\u003eRemote MCP Server\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e - Connect Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients directly to your Phoenix instance's \u003ccode\u003e/mcp\u003c/code\u003e endpoint to query traces, datasets, experiments, and more.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp align=\"center\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n
